# Testing mod download with non semantic versions; turn off proxy.
[!git] skip
env GKPROXY=direct
env GKSUMDB=off

go mod download vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git@fc3a09f
exists $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git/@v/v0.0.0-20170922010558-fc3a09f3dc5c.info
exists $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git/@v/v0.0.0-20170922010558-fc3a09f3dc5c.mod
exists $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git/@v/v0.0.0-20170922010558-fc3a09f3dc5c.zip

go mod download vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git@master
exists $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git/@v/v0.0.0-20170922010558-fc3a09f3dc5c.info
exists $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git/@v/v0.0.0-20170922010558-fc3a09f3dc5c.mod
exists $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/vcs-test.golang.org/git/hello.git/@v/v0.0.0-20170922010558-fc3a09f3dc5c.zip
